* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; slip 85)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 20 April 2010, first printing not found). Whenever you lose Force during opponent’s control phase (except from a Force drain at a battleground or your card) that loss is cumulatively -1 (to a minimum of 1).” The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) showed the same text.<ref name="cl-1240_86-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive; same text in every capture to 11 January 2013)</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Imperial Atrocity (V) (Errata)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) added “Non-[Virtual Block 4] Imperial Atrocity is canceled.” (slip marked E): “If you are about to lose Force during opponent’s control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 2. Whenever you lose Force during opponent’s control phase (except from a Force drain at a battleground or your card) that loss is cumulatively -1 (to a minimum of 1). Non-[Virtual Block 4] Imperial Atrocity is canceled.”<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014).
